channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: WorldRemit Founder Takes Aim at Global Migrant Banking Market
item.description: WorldRemit Group Ltd. founder Ismail Ahmed, who helped build one of the world’s biggest digital money-transfer businesses, is starting a new fintech aimed at giving migrants a broader suite of financial services as the amount they send home approaches $1 trillion a year.
item.dc:creator: Loni Prinsloo

item.title: US Blacklists Megaspeed After Nvidia Spying Scandal
item.description: The Trump administration has put Megaspeed International on a US trade blacklist that bars it from buying advanced AI chips, targeting a Singapore-based firm at the heart of the scandal that briefly cost Jensen Huang his job at Nvidia. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Rajan Warns AI Boom Faces a Reckoning on Returns
item.description: University of Chicago Booth School of Business Finance Professor Raghuram Rajan says the key question hanging over the artificial intelligence (AI) boom is whether massive investment in compute can generate returns large enough to justify the capital being deployed. He adds that as supply expands, weaker-than-expected demand could create oversupply and put pressure on valuations across the AI ecosystem. Rajan, who is also US Fed Balance Sheet Task Force Co-Chair and Former RBI Governor, speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: The Path Ahead as Jensen Huang Returns as Nvidia’s CEO
item.description: Less than two weeks after Jensen Huang left Nvidia under the cloud of scandal, he is reclaiming the titles of president and chief executive officer. The board reinstated Jensen Huang as head of the world’s largest chipmaker in one of the most startling corporate comebacks in history, sending the stock on its biggest rally in decades. Our guests weigh in on Bloomberg TV. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Malaysia Tells Data Centers to Cut Off Firms on US Blacklist
item.description: Malaysia will advise data center operators not to host, lease space nor provide services to seven companies newly placed on a US trade blacklist, stepping up efforts to prevent the country’s booming industry from being used to circumvent American technology restrictions.
item.dc:creator: Danial Azhar

item.title: Fujitsu CTO on AI Focus & Outlook
item.description: Vivek Mahajan, CTO of Fujitsu, discusses the global rollout of the company's Monaka server and its strategy to build infrastructure for sovereign AI. He says Fujitsu is targeting sectors where security is critical, including defense, finance, government and manufacturing, as demand for trusted AI infrastructure grows. He speaks with Avril Hong on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US Blacklists Alibaba-Owned Company in Setback to AI Ambitions
item.description: The Trump administration blacklisted a Singaporean subsidiary of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. along with several entities affiliated with Megaspeed International, the firm at the heart of a scandal that briefly cost Jensen Huang his job as Nvidia Corp. chief executive officer.
item.dc:creator: Mackenzie Hawkins and Luz Ding

item.title: Trump’s Role in Huang’s Return
item.description: Bloomberg's Michael Shepard says Donald Trump played a key role in Jensen Huang’s return to NVIDIA after he was forced to resign amid revelations about multiple extramarital affairs, including with a suspected spy. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Japan Stocks Rebound as Huang’s Return Resuscitates AI Trade
item.description: Japanese stocks rose as Jensen Huang’s return to lead Nvidia Corp. eased concerns about a slowdown in AI investment that had intensified following his departure.
item.dc:creator: Aya Wagatsuma and Momoka Yokoyama

item.title: Singapore Sees AI Boom Fueling Fastest Growth in Five Years
item.description: Singapore further raised this year’s growth forecast as the artificial intelligence boom delivers a larger-than-expected lift to the economy, defying the drag from higher oil prices and rising investor worries.
item.dc:creator: Claire Jiao

item.title: OpenAI Staffer Likely Captured Secrets on Hidden Bug, US Says
item.description: US prosecutors say the former engineer at OpenAI charged with bugging an office conference room likely intercepted trade secrets and possessed a photograph of what appears to be a term sheet for a “strategic partnership” between the ChatGPT maker and another company.
item.dc:creator: Madlin Mekelburg

item.title: Stunning Reversal: Jensen's Second Act
item.description: Jensen Huang is back at the helm of Nvidia following a stunning reversal by the chipmaker’s board. Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow explains how the decision came together, the market’s euphoric response and why Huang’s return leaves some major questions unanswered. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: RBC Has Ideas For Canada to Unlock Tech GDP Gains as NVIDIA Rallies
item.description: Plus: Why COP talks failed
item.dc:creator: Derek Decloet

item.title: Jensen Huang Returns as Nvidia Fuels Historic Rally
item.description: The Close brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Gabelli Funds Portfolio Manager, Growth Portfolios MD John Belton, London Business School Leadership Institute Founding Director Randall Peterson, Raymond James Data Infrastructure & Semiconductors MD Simon Leopold, Center For a New American Security Senior Fellow & Director Emily Kilcrease, Wedbush Securities Senior VP, Equity Research Alicia Reese, Kayne Anderson Rudnick Portfolio Manager, Senior Research Analyst Julie Biel, AlphaSimplex Chief Research Strategist & Portfolio Manager Katy Kaminski, Evercore ISI Technical Analysis Head Rich Ross, NYU Emeritus Professor, Psychology & Neural Science Gary Marcus, University of Delaware Founding Director, Weinburg Center for Corporate Governance Charles Elson, & CSIS Senior Fellow Henrietta Levin. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Nvidia Cannot Rely on Jensen Huang
item.description: If Jensen Huang can do one productive thing after returning as Nvidia’s CEO, it’s to start reorganizing the company so it can survive without him, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Dave Lee says. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: The Chinese AI Aspirants Drawing Big Bets to Take on DeepSeek
item.description: From Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.’s recently departed AI architect to a former intern at ByteDance Ltd., a new wave of Chinese researchers is starting their own specialist labs and drawing huge sums of venture capital to take on far larger players like DeepSeek.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: Circular Financing Will Now Be Under a Microscope After Jensen Huang’s Return, Warns Gary Marcus
item.description: Gary Marcus discusses whether Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia - and the reported involvement of President Trump and the White House- has reinflated the AI bubble. Nvidia surged 31% in the session, but Marcus notes the stock had remained well below its peak. He argues Huang now faces greater scrutiny, including potential congressional investigations, shareholder lawsuits and questions about possible insider trading involving the White House. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Katy Kaminsky Reacts to NVDA Surge After Huang Returns
item.description: Katy Kaminski, Chief Research Strategist and Portfolio Manager at AlphaSimplex Group, says Nvidia’s sharp jump underscored how concentrated and pervasive the AI trade has become. She notes that its influence extends beyond equities and that the scale of recent market moves shows how important the theme has become. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Why Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Matters So Much to the Stock Market
item.description: The decision by Nvidia Corp.’s board of directors to restore Jensen Huang as chief executive officer on Nov. 23 after President Donald Trump pressed for the move speaks to the enormous impact both of Huang on the company and of the company on the larger stock market.
